papers.title: Self-Revising Discovery Systems for Science: A Categorical Framework for Agentic Artificial Intelligence
papers.summary: Audits representational revision through typed evidence transport and residuals.

representation.rationale: Accepted symbolic revisions receive post-hoc schema audits.

transfer.rationale: Mechanics supplies an operational discovery-system grammar.

formal.rationale: Explicit preservation conditions; software lacks full functorial certification.

dynamics.rationale: Collective modes explain normalized fluctuation patterns.

organization.rationale: Artifact needs and mutation coordinate distributed work.

robustness.rationale: Paired MDL and adversarial stages; no fixed held-out benchmark.

surprise.observation: Accepted law multiplies log-compliance by slow-mode participation.
surprise.interpretation: Local softness depends on collective participation.
surprise.boundary: An admitted product over existing GNM quantities; schema-relative novelty, not universal discovery.

detail.observation: V2 retains compliance; HEA fatigue replaces the main fiber-network case.
detail.consequence: Fiber AIC is supplementary; MDL gain is not categorical discovery cost.

read: V2 main methods/results and formal propositions
notRead: Supplementary files; code execution; full v1

papers.title: A Category-Theoretic Framework from Biological Mechanics to Engineered Stimulus-Response Systems
papers.status: Published, Journal of the Mechanics and Physics of Solids 216, 106780
papers.version: Reviewed arXiv:2604.26367v2, 20 August 2026; journal record verified
papers.summary: Composes biological mechanics into printed actuator specifications.

representation.rationale: Dynamical interfaces connect hierarchy and manufacturing.

transfer.rationale: Biological architecture transfers to tested printed actuators.

formal.rationale: Composition preserves simulation conditions, conditional on valid models.

explanation.rationale: Stimulus and kinematic modules recombine predictively.

validation.rationale: Four fabricated actuator classes test central pipeline.

robustness.rationale: Small replications and marginal process windows; joint uncertainty open.

surprise.observation: Thermal twisting combines two previously tested modules.
surprise.interpretation: Validated interfaces can generate an additional actuator class.
surprise.boundary: Direct mechanics also derives it; one recombination demonstrates limited scope.

detail.observation: Validation measures equilibrium angles, n=3–4 per class.
detail.consequence: Transient accuracy and broad manufacturing robustness remain unestablished.

papers.title: Category Theory Based Solution for the Building Block Replacement Problem in Materials Design
papers.summary: Ologs make constrained substitution comparable across material systems.

transfer.rationale: Fruit mixtures and laminates share typed replacement structure.

formal.rationale: Commuting paths and data migration constrain queries.

explanation.rationale: Abstract correspondence exposes common substitution equations.

validation.rationale: Illustrative calculations; no fabricated replacement test.

robustness.rationale: Residuals and constraints discussed; narrow examples.

surprise.observation: Seemingly distant mixtures share a replacement-query schema.
surprise.interpretation: Reusable relational structure can survive substrate changes.
surprise.boundary: Aggregation physics remains domain-specific; schema isomorphism does not equal physical equivalence.

detail.observation: Laminate calculation retains only in-plane ABD components.
detail.consequence: Out-of-plane replacement requires nonlinear solving and additional constraints.

papers.title: Materials by Design: Merging Proteins and Music
papers.summary: Transfers hierarchical silk assembly relationships into musical composition.

representation.rationale: Hierarchy and connectivity replace sequence-only encoding.

transfer.rationale: Explicit distant-domain mapping produces flute compositions.

dynamics.rationale: Assembly and temporal music structure are central.

explanation.rationale: Network connectivity explains reviewed fiber-formation contrast.

validation.rationale: Compositions instantiate mapping; material improvement return loop untested.

surprise.observation: Stronger individual proteins can fail to form fibers.
surprise.interpretation: Excessive local aggregation can defeat network formation.
surprise.boundary: Mechanism is reviewed prior experiment/simulation, not proof musical aesthetics predicts materials.

detail.observation: fMRI assessment and music-to-material improvement are future proposals.
detail.consequence: Performed sonification does not establish predictive reverse transfer.

read: Primary manuscript text and figure captions
notRead: Audio; supplementary mapping rules; prior-data studies
